body.summary: Diffs in the chat's diff widget are coloured by syntax and open the file at the clicked line. highlight.js core plus a fixed language subset is bundled as its own generated module (webview-hljs.ts, 69 KB of a 250 KB budget) and loaded in the chat shell only; each side of a diff section is tokenised separately and the lines are built from text nodes and class-named spans, never assigned markup, with a plain-text fallback. Token colours reuse the chat's existing theme variables. A diff line or the header path posts open-code-ref through the links story's sink and host opener. One departure from the LLD wording, approved in the plan: the shared fake DOM gained a textOf helper instead of a children-joining textContent getter, because the getter change broke 11 unrelated UX-card tests. Live checks were run by the user in VS Code; scope in the evidence.
